scene:
The picture has three areas side by side, read left to right, with no titles or headings above them.

On the left third: three items stacked vertically, each an icon with its label, and each with an arrow pointing right toward the centre: a blank sheet of paper with only a small padlock and a small calendar clipped to it (no words, no signatures on the paper), labelled LOAN CONDITION (arrow solid, navy); a hand dropping a card into a ballot box, labelled DIRECTOR'S VOTE (arrow solid, navy); a pale, faded bar chart of other companies drawn in light grey, labelled BENCHMARK (its arrow thin, dotted and faded, to show it is only information).

In the centre third, top to bottom:
Top: a phone showing an app screen, crossed out by a large ochre X and covered by a closed shutter, labelled MOBILE APP: STOPPED. Beside it, exactly eight small person figures (count: 8) walking away, labelled 8 ROLES: €72K A MONTH.
Middle: a simple month-by-month bar strip with no axis text: three ochre bars hanging BELOW a baseline on the left (costs paid out first), labelled once LEAVING COSTS €120K FIRST; then teal bars rising ABOVE the baseline that grow taller to the right, with the tallest ones marked by a small flag labelled FULL SAVING FROM APRIL.
Bottom: a dashed ochre horizontal line labelled RESERVE €400K; a coin stack stands ON TOP of that dashed line, like on a shelf, rising above it, and the coin stack is labelled 30 JUNE: €488K. Nothing is drawn below the dashed line.

On the right third: an open office door drawn in the middle. On the outside of the door, a person walking out carrying a folder, labelled LEAVERS: WRITTEN TERMS. On the inside of the door, a small group of four people at a table reading one printed list together, labelled STAYERS: STOPPED-WORK LIST.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: LOAN CONDITION, DIRECTOR'S VOTE, BENCHMARK, MOBILE APP: STOPPED, 8 ROLES: €72K A MONTH, LEAVING COSTS €120K FIRST, FULL SAVING FROM APRIL, RESERVE €400K, 30 JUNE: €488K, LEAVERS: WRITTEN TERMS, STAYERS: STOPPED-WORK LIST. The documents, phone screen, chart, folder and list carry no writing or numbers. Never write the words LEFT, CENTRE, RIGHT, ZONE or any heading. Any other text is a defect.
alt: Three pressures, a loan condition, a director's vote and a faded benchmark, feed one plan: the mobile app stops and eight roles go, saving €72,000 a month; €120,000 of leaving costs come first and the full saving starts only in April; cash on 30 June stands at €488,000 above the €400,000 reserve; at a door, those leaving carry written terms and those staying hold a published list of stopped work.
caption: Find the source of the pressure, cut by work, reconcile cash by date, and look after both sides of the door.
